source.title: Spectral Gambler's Shawl — indexed original Wowhead Looter disenchant table
source.author: Wowhead Looter aggregate (anonymous cumulative submissions)

notes: Original item-side Wowhead Looter source displayed 16 disenchant operations and 3 separately listed Refulgent Crystal rows. This is displayed material row 1 of 3 for epic rogue cloak; source-displayed row hit share 50%, not an independently measured prospective probability. All three rows share a single cumulative anonymous cohort. The three same-named output links are hidden in indexed HTML; exact output IDs 219952/219954/219955 and quality ranks CANNOT be matched to these row positions. No output units, min/max, per-cast positive stack sizes, 0/1/2 histogram, zero-output operations, skill, specialization, data capture date, build/hotfix, bonus-item variant or Resourcefulness basis is provided. Item was introduced in patch 11.1.0 but that does not establish sample patch. Bonus URL variants mirror the same cumulative source table and must never be counted again as independent observations. Current Retail eligibility, numeric expected yield and gold EV remain unverified.
